title: Backing India's Start-Up Champions
tagline: India celebrates cricketers and founders equally. Only one gets a stadium. We built one for both.
summary: 81 television films, a newspaper front page and 200+ social posts for 20 founders, with no cameras, sets or lights.

sections.label: The idea
sections.title: Put founders on the screen cricket fans are already watching.
sections.body: The T20 World Cup season is when the nation watches together. Razorpay set out to back its start-up champions where attention already was, treating founders the way the country treats cricketers: with a stadium, a jersey and a player card.

sections.text: Viewers didn't see an ad. They saw a founder who belonged on that screen.

sections.label: TV ads
sections.title: Designed to look like the broadcast, not interrupt it.
sections.body:
**81 films. 20 match dates. Zero shoots.** Each founder was lit three ways, warm daylight, floodlit blue and night drama, matched to every match slot.

Every film mirrored cricket player-card aesthetics: centre-composed, sportsman poses, stadium environment.

sections.caption: Television: lower-thirds, player cards and three lighting environments

sections.label: The pipeline
sections.title: 20 founders. One photo each. No shoots, no studios, no waiting.
sections.body:
A custom avatar tool, built on the Nano Banana API and Gemini AI Studio, took a single reference image and returned a full campaign visual library: sportsman poses, campaign costume, expressions tuned to each founder's personality. 4K output, one click.

Every founder walked into the campaign looking like they had always belonged on that stage.

sections.label: Social
sections.title: Every founder. Every platform. One pipeline.
sections.body:
200+ extended social posts carried the campaign forward, including founders who did not appear in the TV spots. Drop in a founder photo and their business story and the pipeline returns a fully composed, campaign-ready post: title layouts per personality, costume, pose, lighting and background, all handled.

No individual design sessions. No back and forth. Just output.

sections.label: Print
sections.title: The nation reads the paper. We put founders on the front page.
sections.body: The same pipeline that built the TV assets produced full-page newspaper ads: same founder, same costume, same campaign language, in the hands of the same audience the morning after the match.

sections.caption: Print: founders on the front page

images.caption: 81 ad films, 1 newspaper ad, 200+ social posts. No cameras. No sets. No lights.
